svg.aria-label: Grid of 30 stores. For each store, five bars show whether the start page opened on Plain · Default · Stealth · Residential · Mac, and a label names the lightest Anchor setup that opened it.
svg.text: bars, left to right: Plain · Default · Stealth · Residential · Mac
Label: lightest Anchor setup that opened the store. One visit per cell, so a single cell can flip on a repeat.
